title: Caprese Panini (Pressed Mozzarella, Tomato and Basil Sandwich)
summary: Ciabatta rubbed with garlic, brushed with olive oil outside and filled with fresh mozzarella, blotted tomato and basil, then pressed in a pan until golden and melting. Ready in under 20 minutes.
equipment: large non-stick frying pan or panini press
heavy saucepan or second pan to press

ingredients.item: slices ciabatta or crusty bread, 1 cm thick
fresh mozzarella, sliced and patted dry
ripe medium tomatoes, sliced 5 mm thick

steps.title: Prep the filling
steps.text: Lay the tomato slices on kitchen paper for 5 min and pat the mozzarella dry; removing excess moisture keeps the bread crisp. Rub one side of each bread slice with the cut garlic and brush the other side with oil.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: On the unoiled side of two slices, layer half the mozzarella, then the tomato seasoned with pepper, the basil and the rest of the cheese. Top with the remaining slices, oiled side up.

steps.title: Press and toast
steps.text: Put the sandwiches in the cold pan, weigh them down with the saucepan and cook over medium heat for about 4 min until deeply golden. Flip, press again and cook for 2-3 min more until the cheese has melted.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Leave for 2 min so the melted cheese sets slightly, then cut in half and serve warm.

tips: A spoonful of pesto spread inside adds extra basil flavour.
Starting in a cold pan gives the cheese time to melt before the bread browns.
storage: Best eaten hot. Assemble up to 2 hours ahead, cover and chill, then toast just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
